name: Evangelie ot Semyona
source:
What will happen to a person who has lost all meaning in their existence? To a person who has realized the insignificance of their being and of themselves? And what if, having completely freed himself from any boundaries of morality and ethics, he decides to make himself a God?

This is a story about a hunter who is actually a victim of the twisted horror of his own mind. Sounds familiar, does it not? As if you have already heard this somewhere and played it, and it does not matter whether this refers to the [url=/v35814]Odinochka[/url] or the first emanation of [url=/v55320]Blazhennyj[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3730748867]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个人失去了存在的意义，会发生什么？对于一个已经意识到自己的存在和自己的微不足道的人来说？如果他完全摆脱了道德和伦理的界限，决定让自己成为上帝怎么办？

这是一个关于猎人的故事，他实际上是自己心灵扭曲恐怖的受害者。听起来很熟悉，不是吗？就好像你已经在某处听过并播放过它一样，无论这是否指的是 [url=/v35814]Odinochka[/url] 还是 [url=/v55320]Blazhennyj[/url] 的第一个流露并不重要。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3730748867]Steam[/url]]
